run_collage_video: run the script to export a collage MP4 video from camera image subdirectories
run_collage_with_fps: run the script with a custom framerate to export a collage video from images
run_collage_without_labels: run the script with no labels to export a collage video without filename overlays
run_collage_custom_src: run the script pointing to a custom source directory of camera image subfolders
run_collage_4k: run the script to generate a 3840x2160 collage video from multi-camera JPEG images
